caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular section of fabric with embroidery designs. The background is a light cream or beige color. There are two parallel columns of green geometric patterns running vertically down the center, each composed of hexagonal shapes connected by horizontal lines, with small green starburst or asterisk shapes inside each hexagon. Between these columns is a vertical line resembling a seam, filled with small, closely spaced, orange-brown diagonal stitches. On the right side of the fabric, there is a single vertical zigzag line embroidered in a reddish-brown color, forming a repetitive triangular or chevron pattern. The whole composition is centered on a blank background, and the drawing is bordered by a white margin. There are numbers and a signature written near the bottom edge of the paper.
title: Sampler (Stitching)
